provenance.author: this repository
provenance.method: rank-2 exclusion over all 7,439,040 four-qutrit stabilizer states, held as phase codes

notes: Closes this cell as a route to the published exponent, which would need rank 2 here. The dictionary is enumerated as int8 phase codes in about 30 s and 600 MB (the complex form is 4.8 GB), and the rank-2 test is one canonicalise-and-sort over quotient directions, so the certificate runs in about two minutes against the 2.2 hours of the streaming version proposed in PR #20, which this supersedes. The exclusion is numerical and rests on a margin: the closest any two key-adjacent quotient directions come to parallel is reported by the script and must clear 1 - 1e-6 by 0.01. A rank-3 exclusion for the same cell has also been run here (chi >= 4) and exceeds the default certificate budget.
